data.name: Sorcerer
data.description: [Not Implemented]A character who chooses sorcerer as her secondary class gains the following secondary class features.

raw_tokens.value: [Not Implemented]A character who chooses sorcerer as her secondary class gains the following secondary class features.
&nl;Bloodline: At 1st level, she must select a sorcerer bloodline. She treats her character level as her effective sorcerer level for all bloodline powers.
&nl;Bloodline Power: At 3rd level, she gains her bloodline's 1st-level bloodline power.
&nl;Improved Bloodline Power: At 7th level, she gains her bloodline's 3rd-level bloodline power
&nl;Blood Feat: At 11th level, she gains one of her bloodline's feats or Eschew Materials.
&nl;Greater Bloodline Power: At 15th level, she gains her bloodline's 9th-level bloodline power.
&nl;True Bloodline Power: At 19th level, she gains her bloodline's 15th-level bloodline power.
